name: Walls with depth
about: Logs, trim and a deep window.

steps.title: A wall with a deep window
steps.say: Build a flat wall with a hole for a window. Put the glass one block further in, not in line with the wall.
steps.tip: A deep window makes a wall look thick and strong.

steps.title: Logs that stick out
steps.say: Put a column of logs at each end, one block out in front of the wall.
steps.tip: On a long wall, add a column of logs every 4 or 5 blocks.

steps.title: Upside-down stairs
steps.say: Put upside-down stairs along the top, between the logs. Put three more under the window, as a ledge.
steps.tip: To place a stair upside down, point at the top half of the block's side.

steps.title: A stone bottom row
steps.say: Swap the bottom row of planks for stone bricks. It gives the wall a strong base.
steps.tip: Two or three kinds of block in one wall look better than one.
